purpose: Distinguish a cloud-radiation-precipitation deficit from land-surface feedback without changing the failed V29 physics.

decision_rule.cloud_radiation_first: HICAR cloud/hydrometeor and radiative deficits precede the surface-flux or soil divergence.
decision_rule.land_first: HICAR soil-state and turbulent-flux divergence precede the cloud/radiative deficit.
decision_rule.otherwise: INCONCLUSIVE: do not alter physics or submit the 72-hour summer rerun.

next_authorization: At most one correction, only if this baseline identifies one leading mechanism.
